posts.title: Unfortunately, I Think LLMs Might Be Useful for Development Now
posts.description: A year ago, I thought the LLM bubble was going to completely burst under its own weight. Now, I'm not so sure. I still think the LLM sector is overvalued and destined for a big correction. But based on what I'm seeing in the software industry, I don't think LLMs are going to zero-- at least without some sort of intervention. So now my question is what do we do?
